title: Amy and the Bent Orchard Path
synopsis: Amy visits the orchard, discovers that her straight map line misses a path bend, and names the two-trunk Doorway Tree.
continuity_state: Before: Season three is complete; the yellow map includes the original southern orchard and old mill; the path is drawn straight. No Button Town game exists yet. After: With Grandma May and Ben, Amy notices the orchard path curves around the existing two-trunk tree before continuing to the fenced old mill. She draws the accurate bend and names the Doorway Tree; Ben imagines a doorway. The tree itself is ordinary.
